SUMMARY & PURPOSE

Side-by-side section with sticky headline/story progression beside scrollable detail cards.

WHEN IT WORKS (IDEAL FOR)

Detailed multi-step technical narratives
WHEN IT IS INAPPROPRIATE (AVOID FOR)
•
Small mobile-only embeds without scrolling room
JOBS TO BE DONE
Keep high-level narrative anchored while user reads detailed feature cards

Clear hierarchy, responsive layout, accessible typography
